headline_correction.why_it_was_false: That number was produced by checking only whether a URL happened to be embedded in evidence ALREADY STORED on the venue record. It was never the result of searching for these venues. Venues such as The Forum Bath, the London Palladium, Theatre Royal Drury Lane and Bradford Live were in that list.
headline_correction.what_is_actually_known: Of the 257 venues ACTUALLY researched in this package, 145 (56.4%) have a real, validated official web presence - a venue site or an official operator venue page that the writer re-fetched and identity-checked on 2026-09-23. The remaining 1,757 venues of the 2,014 were NOT researched at all, because the session-wide WebSearch budget ran out. Nothing whatsoever is known about their web presence.
headline_correction.how_this_number_was_arrived_at: The two research agents recorded 149 of the 257 researched venues (58.0%) as having an official source. The writer re-fetched every one of those URLs and REJECTED 4 of them (a wrong-city namesake, a non-resolving domain, a Wix domain-not-connected error page and a 404 branch page on a holding-page site), leaving 145 (56.4%). The 4 rejected venues are recorded as needing a further pass, NOT as venues without a website.
headline_correction.never_do_this: Never count, report or imply the 1,766 NOT_YET_RESEARCHED venues as "no website" or "no source found". Absence of research is not evidence of absence.

b_researched_and_no_confident_source_was.caveat: Only 6 venues in the whole 2,014-venue estate have been shown, by a protocol-compliant search, to have no confident source. That is the only defensible "no source" number this package supports.

c_not_researched_at_all.reason: The session-wide WebSearch budget was exhausted (200/200 searches used) before these venues could be reached. NOTHING is known about whether they have a website or a programme source. They are NOT evidence of absence and must never be counted, reported or implied as "no website" or "no source found".

coverage.honest_statement: This package researched 12.76% of the target estate. It corrects the false "2,014 have no website" claim for the researched slice only; the rest of the estate remains unknown.

reason_research_stopped: WEBSEARCH_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED (200/200 session-wide searches used). Hard blocker, not a finding. A follow-up package with a fresh search budget is required to research the remaining 1,766 venues.

writer_reverification.method: Every claimed official URL (155) plus all 30 shared-website URLs were re-fetched over HTTP with a desktop user agent and redirects followed; failures and identity-ambiguous cases were additionally re-checked with an independent fetcher (WebFetch). No search engine was used or scraped - the WebSearch budget was exhausted.

rejections.detail: HTTP 404. legionscotland.org.uk currently serves a Legion Scotland Holding Page at its root and /branches is also 404, so no branch-club page exists to cite. Reproduced independently via WebFetch (404).

HTTP 200, but the live site is 404 Club Not Found at E-1-01 Electric Boulevard, TREC KL, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. It is not the London WC2H record; London appears only as a future-expansion aspiration. Rejected as an official website for the London venue.
HTTP 404 on / and /whats-on; the served body is a Wix ConnectYourDomain Error page, i.e. the domain is no longer connected to a live site. Reproduced independently via WebFetch (404).
DNS lookup failed (ENOTFOUND) for both www.coachworkse8.com and coachworkse8.com. The domain does not resolve, so it cannot be recorded as this venue official website.

unverifiable_hosts.detail: HTTP 403 Forbidden to automated fetching (host is on the known-unfetchable list). Not verified by this package; the researcher search-level identification is retained as-is and is NOT upgraded.

Infinite redirect loop on both https://www.bathforum.co.uk/ and https://bathforum.co.uk/ (Node fetch: redirect count exceeded; WebFetch: Too many redirects (exceeded 10)). The page could not be read by this package.
TLS handshake fails with CERT_HAS_EXPIRED on astonsbedford.co.uk and www.astonsbedford.co.uk. Reproduced independently via WebFetch (certificate has expired).
Connection timed out (UND_ERR_CONNECT_TIMEOUT) via Node fetch; WebFetch returned connect ECONNREFUSED 46.32.252.220:443. Origin unreachable at re-verification time.
Cloudflare HTTP 522 Connection timed out on two independent attempts (Node fetch and WebFetch).
Cloudflare HTTP 526 Invalid SSL certificate on two independent attempts (Node fetch and WebFetch).

defect_fixes_applied.fix: Downgraded HIGH -> MEDIUM because each row's own identity_evidence states the destination page was not fetched (403 / 522 / not fetched). None of the three is proposed for canonical evidence.
Flagged below_minimum_search_standard=true. Excluded from every "real search proved no source" count and surfaced in no-source-after-search.json as needing a further pass.
Reclassified as NOT_RESEARCHED_BLOCKED and counted with the NOT_YET_RESEARCHED population, never as a negative.

canonical_evidence.rule: Appended only for HIGH-confidence, writer-re-verified, genuinely official venue or operator venue pages. Never for a third-party ticketing page, a social page, a search result, a directory or an uncertain operator page. Existing evidence was never removed or rewritten; no address, coordinate or location_status was changed.

sources_activated: NONE. This package creates and modifies no source registry entry and touches no sources/*.json, data/public/* or venues/manual-coordinates.json.

data_quality_findings.rule: Reported only. This package does NOT mutate any canonical record's city, nation, name, address or coordinates. Fixing these is a separate governed package.

pre_existing_venue_contract_violations.error: a GEOCODED venue must carry a non-empty address
pre_existing_venue_contract_violations.detail: Found by the writer while testing the evidence append. 64 of the 3,537 venues in venues/uk.json already fail ingestion/venue/contract.mjs at the base commit (198b55e25c4254dfa354d87d55b70c4b11e37510) because they are location_status=GEOCODED with address=null (e.g. venue-london-adelphi-theatre). This is PRE-EXISTING and was NOT caused by this package - tests/uk-source-discovery-03-artifacts.test.mjs proves the evidence append changes no venue's validation outcome. Fixing it is a separate governed package.

cross_shard_operator_leads.operator_name: ANGUSalive (Angus Council leisure and culture trust)
cross_shard_operator_leads.note: Venue pages follow https://angusalive.scot/theatres-venues/our-venues/<slug>/ - confirmed slugs include webster-memorial-theatre (Arbroath, shard A), forfar-reid-hall, montrose-town-hall and kirriemuir-town-hall. Combined listings at https://angusalive.scot/whats-on/. Flagged for Agent B in case Forfar/Montrose/Kirriemuir venues fall in shard B.

Covers Snape Maltings (Concert Hall, Britten Studio, Jerwood Kiln Studio, Granary/Pond/Quay Galleries), The Pumphouse Aldeburgh and The Red House, plus regularly-used external venues: Aldeburgh Parish Church, Aldeburgh Jubilee Hall, Blythburgh Church, Orford Church, Orford Town Hall, St Peter's by the Waterfront Ipswich, St Edmundsbury Cathedral and Theatre Royal Bury St Edmunds. Combined listings at https://www.brittenpearsarts.org/whats-on.

Four venues: The Landmark Ilfracombe (landmark-ilfracombe.com), Queens Theatre Barnstaple (queenstheatre-barnstaple.com, 100 Boutport Street EX31 1SY), New Theatre Peterborough and Key Theatre Peterborough. Shared North Devon box office 01271 316523. Flagged for Agent B in case the Queens Theatre or the Peterborough venues fall in shard B.

Operates Theatre at The Mill (Mossley Mill, Newtownabbey - shard A) plus sister venues The Courtyard Theatre and The Old Courthouse Theatre, both named on theatreatthemill.com. Shared box office at tickets.theatreatthemill.com/antrimandnewtownabbeybc/website/EventList.aspx. Flagged for Agent B.

GLL/Better operates many UK council leisure-centre theatres and arts venues under betterboxoffice.co.uk/<venue-slug>, with dated listings rendered server-side (Rails). Venue-specific slugs are official operator venue pages. Confirmed via Terry O'Toole Theatre (Lincoln), whose own domain 301-redirects to the Better Box Office venue page.

Pub Invest Group holds the copyright on Eric's Live (Mathew Street, Liverpool) and operates a number of Liverpool city-centre bars/venues on separate WordPress sites. No single venue index was located; noting the operator so its other venues are not treated as unrelated.

Many UK students' unions run their ents listings on MSL, exposing a consistent <union-domain>/ents/eventlist/<category>/ path with server-rendered, dated, venue-labelled gig listings (confirmed at Liverpool Guild of Students for Mountford Hall). Any students'-union venue in either shard is worth checking for this exact path before searching.

Nederlander UK operates exactly three London theatres, each with an official venue page carrying dated show runs: Dominion (nederlander.co.uk/dominion/), Aldwych (/aldwych/) and Adelphi (/adelphi/, co-owned with LW Theatres). WordPress front end, ticketing via ticketing.nederlander.co.uk (Primary Ticket Ltd) and ticketing.lwtheatres.co.uk. I researched Adelphi and Aldwych only; the DOMINION THEATRE row, wherever it sits, is resolved by the same index.

LW Theatres operates six West End venues - Theatre Royal Drury Lane, the London Palladium, Cambridge Theatre, Adelphi Theatre (co-owned with Nederlander), Gillian Lynne Theatre and His Majesty's Theatre - each at lwtheatres.co.uk/theatres/<slug>/ with a /whats-on/ sub-path. WARNING: the whole domain returns HTTP 403 to the WebFetch tool, so these pages could not be opened; any agent hitting an LW venue will need a different retrieval route.

Large London pub/bar group with an official venue page per site at urbanpubsandbars.com/venues/<slug> (confirmed for The East Dulwich Tavern). Several London live-music pubs in either shard are likely to belong to it.
